subject: Startups
title: Global VC Beyond Silicon Valley
description: A quick win: understand Global VC Beyond Silicon Valley.

hook.text: In 2010, 70% of global VC went to US startups. By 2023, that share dropped below 40%. The world caught up.

buildup.text: India's VC scene exploded with firms like Accel India and Tiger Global backing Flipkart, Ola, and Swiggy.

discovery.text: Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Africa are producing unicorns. Local VCs understand markets that US firms miss.

twist.text: US mega-funds like Tiger Global flooded into global deals in 2021, then pulled back sharply. Local VCs remained.

climax.text: The future of VC is global. The best founder in the world might be in Lagos, not San Francisco.

punchline.text: Capital went global. The next unicorn could be anywhere.

quiz.question: How has global VC distribution changed since 2010?
options: US share dropped as other regions grew rapidly
